title: 第19章 图谋苏珂亲情变质第20章 散财童子地元参
slug: 凡人修仙捡个仙子做老婆
content_zh:
“安师姐，你回来啦？”
洞府外面，传来甜美又熟悉的声音。
安若曦轻抿红唇，收拾好心情，开启了石门禁制。
一个青稚秀美的少女，笑吟吟的站在外面。一袭白袍如新雪裹身，衬得她通澈澄净，两缕青丝飘动的云鬓掠过小巧精致的面庞，一双眼睛荧光灼灼，挺直的琼鼻，弯弯的檀口，细长的眉毛微挑。
熟悉的神态，熟悉的笑容，让安若曦阴郁的心情稍好了些。
这是她的好姐妹，金阳峰的亲传弟子，柳依依。
“安师姐，你这次出去好久……咦？？”柳依依歪着头，仔细地打量起了面前的安若曦。
“怎么了？哪里不对吗？”安若曦奇怪。
“好像有点不一样了呢。”
“什么不一样？”
“说不出来，感觉……嗯……有韵味了呢。”柳依依娇笑。
“死丫头，胡说什么！”安若曦心里莫名一慌，这么明显吗？
“师姐真是越来越漂亮了，以后也不知道便宜哪个混小子。”
柳依依凑前挽住安若曦：“你是不知道，这一个月进来的那些云下的记名弟子啊，没有一个不站在雕像前发呆的，都被咱万相灵女的美艳惊到了。”
“行了，行了，你来找我就说这些无聊的事？”安若曦没心情跟柳依依玩闹。
“我这不是听说安师姐回来了吗，过来看看你。顺便……”
柳依依从灵袋里取出一个玉瓶：“呐，我刚炼出来的上品蕴灵丹。”
安若曦想要拒绝，她暂时用不着蕴灵丹了，但是实在不知道如何跟柳依依解释，哪怕这是她的好姐妹。“我给你拿灵石。”
“给什么灵石，你今天怎么了，不是说好了吗，你的丹药我来负责。再说了，咱万相灵女都用我柳依依的蕴灵丹，也是给我做宣传了。”
“你还用我做宣传？找你柳依依炼丹的弟子，都能从云上金阳峰排到云下九山了。我可是听说了，有些弟子买回去都舍不得用呢。”

“所以我才不给那些男弟子炼丹，想想就恶心。”柳依依撇了撇嘴，一脸的厌弃。
“这蕴灵丹我收下了。你如果需要灵石了，我再给你。”安若曦没心思再跟柳依依多聊，简单找个理由，开启禁制，回到了洞府里。
禁制外，柳依依看着面前石门，今天的师姐，似乎很烦躁啊。她嘴角泛起抹异样的笑意，但很快敛去，脚步轻快的离开了这里。
周元舒舒服服的泡了个澡，换好新的衣袍，系好衣带，走到浴室的铜镜前面，抬眼望去，不由得怔住了。
镜中少年眉眼依旧，却又陌生的让他恍惚。脸色还显暗淡，但是不再蜡黄，脸颊还是消瘦，但已没有凹陷，鼻梁挺直，嘴唇轻抿，下颌线条清晰，面目轮廓看起来棱角分明，且透着正在舒展的俊朗。
袖袍宽大，却恰好合身，衬得肩背舒展，身姿挺拔，真有几分修行之人的模样。
“难怪苏师姐按耐不住。可惜啊，咱是有家室的人。”
“我那老婆人很好的，也没杀我。”
周元自娱自乐两句，拿起玉石挂到脖子上，收进衣领里。等到哪天突破七重天了，再推演一次，看看灵宗里能得到着什么机缘。
拿起破旧的衣服，从里面翻出了包裹的地元参，藏到了卧室里。
灵宗里强者众多，奇人遍地，这种宝贝不能再继续待在身上了，免得被人察觉，引起不必要的麻烦。
弱小是原罪。
必须小心谨慎。
周元把一百五十二颗灵石分别装进两个锦袋，贴身收好，离开了岩洞，到玄青谷买些灵米。
“周师弟，天都要黑了，这是要去哪？”一个方脸男子从前面昏暗的林子里走了出来，嘴角勾着笑，眼神却明显泛着冷意。
“想随便转转，熟悉下咱们奎阆山。”周元奇怪，这个周庭好像故意在这里等着他。
“去找苏师姐吧。”周庭鼻息冷哼，走向周元。
“只是随便看看。”
content_en:
"Sister An, are you back?"
Outside the cave, a sweet and familiar voice came.
An Ruoxi lightly pursed her red lips, regained her composure, and opened the stone gate.
A young and beautiful girl stood outside with a smile. She was dressed in a white robe that was wrapped like fresh snow, making her crystal clear. Two strands of fluttering black hair swept over her small and delicate face. Her eyes were bright with fluorescent light, her nose was straight, her mouth was curved, and her slender eyebrows were slightly raised.
The familiar look and smile made An Ruoxi's gloomy mood slightly better.
This is her good sister, Jin Yangfeng's direct disciple, Liu Yiyi.
"Senior Sister An, you've been out for a long time this time... Huh??" Liu Yiyi tilted her head and carefully looked at An Ruoxi in front of her.
"What's wrong? Is something wrong?" An Ruoxi was surprised.
"It seems a little different."
"What's different?"
"I can't put it into words, it feels... um... it has charm." Liu Yiyi smiled sweetly.
"Damn girl, what are you talking about!" An Ruoxi panicked inexplicably. Is it so obvious?
"Senior sister is getting more and more beautiful. I don't know which bastard will be cheaper in the future."
Liu Yiyi stepped forward and held An Ruoxi's arm: "You don't know that among the registered disciples under the cloud who have come in this month, there is no one who does not stand in front of the statue in a daze. They are all shocked by the beauty of our Wanxiang Spirit Girl."
"Okay, okay, you come to me and talk about these boring things?" An Ruoxi was not in the mood to play around with Liu Yiyi.
"Didn't I hear that Senior Sister An is back? Come and see you. By the way..."
Liu Yiyi took out a jade bottle from the spirit bag: "Hey, I just made the top-grade spirit-accumulating pill."
An Ruoxi wanted to refuse. She no longer needed Yunling Pill for the time being, but she really didn't know how to explain it to Liu Yiyi, even if she was her good sister. "I'll get you the spiritual stone."
"What spirit stone are you giving me? What happened to you today? Didn't I agree that I will be responsible for your elixir? Besides, our Wanxiang spirit girl used Liu Yiyi's spirit accumulation elixir to promote me."
"Are you still using me for publicity? The disciples who come to you, Liu Yiyi, to make alchemy, are all lined up from Jinyang Peak on the cloud to the Nine Mountains under the cloud. But I heard that some disciples are reluctant to use it after buying it."
"That's why I don't make elixirs for those male disciples. It makes me sick just thinking about it." Liu Yiyi curled her lips with a look of disgust on her face.
"I'll accept this spirit-accumulating pill. If you need the spirit stone, I'll give it to you." An Ruoxi didn't want to talk to Liu Yiyi any more. She simply found a reason, opened the restriction, and returned to the cave.
Outside the restriction, Liu Yiyi looked at the Shimen in front of her. Today's senior sister seems to be very agitated. A strange smile appeared at the corner of her mouth, but she quickly put it away and left here briskly.
Zhou Yuan took a comfortable bath, changed into a new robe, tied his belt, walked to the bronze mirror in the bathroom, looked up, and couldn't help but be stunned.
The young man's eyebrows in the mirror were still the same, but they were strange and made him feel confused. The complexion is still dull, but no longer sallow, the cheeks are still thin, but no longer sunken, the bridge of the nose is straight, the lips are lightly pursed, the jawline is clear, and the facial contours look sharp and angular, and reveal a stretching handsomeness.
The sleeves of the robe are wide, but they fit just right, making the shoulders and back stretch, and the body is tall and straight. It really looks like a practitioner.
"No wonder Senior Sister Su can't bear it. It's a pity, we are family people."
"My wife is very nice and didn't kill me."
Zhou Yuan entertained himself for a moment, picked up the jade, hung it around his neck, and put it into his collar. Wait until one day to break through the seventh heaven, and then deduce it again to see what opportunities can be obtained in Lingzong.
Picking up the shabby clothes, he dug out the packaged Diyuan Ginseng and hid it in the bedroom.
There are many strong men and strange people in Lingzong. This kind of treasure cannot be kept on the body any longer, lest it be noticed by others and cause unnecessary trouble.
Weakness is the original sin.
Care must be taken.
Zhou YuanbaOne hundred and fifty-two spiritual stones were put into two brocade bags, kept close to the body, left the cave, and went to Xuanqing Valley to buy some spiritual rice.
"Junior Brother Zhou, it's getting dark, where are we going?" A man with a square face walked out of the dim forest in front, with a smile on his lips, but his eyes were obviously cold.
"I want to take a walk around and get acquainted with our Kuilang Mountain." Zhou Yuan was surprised that this Zhou Ting seemed to be waiting for him here on purpose.
"Go find Senior Sister Su." Zhou Ting snorted coldly and walked towards Zhou Yuan.
"Just looking around."
